turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first.
I didn't come for thanks. Who decided on that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Can you read me your notes word for word?
My notes are mine; you'll have my position in writing. But here's one line: "Procedure 4.2, parent contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me."
Not those notes. Your instructions. What were you told to do in this meeting?
Told? Nobody tells me what to do in a meeting about my son, Hale. Answer my question: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
What do you plan to say if I bring up your daughter?
You'll want to be very careful about where that sentence goes. My daughter isn't a student in your class, and if her name comes up again, this conversation continues in the principal's office.
